mapper.update: UPDATE leetcode_recommend_request SET status = #{status}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, finished_at = CASE WHEN #{status} IN ('completed', 'failed') THEN NOW() ELSE finished_at END WHERE request_id = #{requestId}
mapper.select: SELECT i.*, p.id as p_id, p.source_key as p_source_key, p.problem_code as p_problem_code, p.title_main as p_title_main, p.difficulty as p_difficulty, p.estimated_minutes as p_estimated_minutes, p.quality_score as p_quality_score FROM leetcode_recommend_item i LEFT JOIN leetcode_problem_bank p ON i.problem_id = p.id WHERE i.request_id = #{requestId} ORDER BY i.rank_no ASC

SELECT i.*, p.id as p_id, p.source_key as p_source_key, p.problem_code as p_problem_code, p.title_main as p_title_main, p.difficulty as p_difficulty, p.estimated_minutes as p_estimated_minutes, p.quality_score as p_quality_score FROM leetcode_recommend_item i LEFT JOIN leetcode_problem_bank p ON i.problem_id = p.id WHERE i.request_id = #{requestId} AND i.rank_no = #{rankNo}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO leetcode_recommend_item ( request_id, student_id, rank_no, problem_id, score_total, score_need_match, score_difficulty_fit, score_success_prob, score_novelty, score_quality, reason_text, reason_json ) VALUES ( #{requestId}, #{studentId}, #{rankNo}, #{problemId}, #{scoreTotal}, #{scoreNeedMatch}, #{scoreDifficultyFit}, #{scoreSuccessProb}, #{scoreNovelty}, #{scoreQuality}, #{reasonText}, #{reasonJson} )

mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT problem_id FROM leetcode_recommend_item WHERE student_id = #{studentId} AND created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) ORDER BY created_at DESC
